children: Lululemon Athletica appointed two new key executives as Chief Executive Heidi O'Neill rounds out her leadership team to help address slumping sales at the athleisure company.
The company on Friday said it has appointed Ben Hallam as chief brand officer and Emily Sunderland as chief strategy officer, effective Nov. 9 and Nov. 23, respectively
Hallam, who succeeds Nikki Neuburger, most recently served as the senior vice president of marketing at Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts.
Sunderland was a managing director and partner at Boston Consulting Group, succeeding Rachel Acheson.

O'Neill, a former Nike executive, has already made several executive changes since she took the helm of the company in September. Last month, she brought on the former head of Gap's Athleta brand as president and chief product officer, and also tapped a former Walmart executive as chief operating officer.
Lululemon said it's still looking for a chief technology officer and chief communications officer.
